context: Discussing how people interpret events differently
purpose: Examine perception; teach 心理/思考/異なる/観点/あらゆる/したがって/更に/概念

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心理学って、思考のしくみを研究するんですよね。
lines.en: Psychology studies the mechanics of thought, right?
lines.style: engaged student framing the field, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、人の判断は感情とも深く関わります。
lines.en: Yes, human judgment ties deeply to emotion.
lines.style: lecturer adding an essential nuance, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 同じ出来事でも、人によって受け取り方が異なる。
lines.en: Even one event, people receive it differently.
lines.style: student articulating an observation, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう、観点が変われば意味も変わります。
lines.en: Right, change the viewpoint and meaning changes.
lines.style: lecturer reinforcing the principle, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あらゆる場面で、先入観が働くんですね。
lines.style: student generalizing the insight, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: したがって、客観的に見る訓練が必要です。
lines.en: Therefore, training to see objectively is needed.
lines.style: lecturer prescribing a discipline, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 更に、その「客観」という概念も曖昧ですよね。
lines.en: Furthermore, even “objectivity” is a vague concept.
lines.style: student pushing the inquiry deeper, tone holding steady through the whole line
